name: protein-structures
title: Protein structures: experimental (PDB, 1976-2026) and predicted (AlphaFold DB)
description: Experimentally determined structures released in the Protein Data Bank each year from 1976 to 18 November 2026, by experimental method (X-ray, cryo-EM, NMR and others), with cumulative totals; counted from the RCSB PDB Search API. Plus the number of predicted structures in each AlphaFold Protein Structure Database release from 2021 to 2025, from EMBL-EBI's changelog. Frozen snapshot taken on 2026-11-22. The 2026 PDB figures are partial (to 18 November).
